title: Psychology Facts
hook: Stores are hacking your brain. Three ways.
facts: Number one: *anchoring*. A crossed-out price makes the sale price feel cheap.
Number two: *charm pricing*. A price ending in .99 feels smaller than it is.
In Dan Ariely's test, a useless option lifted the pricier pick from *32%* to *84%*.
outro: Now you know how stores play your brain.
